mapper.sql: id , status, is_default, config_json, name, des, create_by, gmt_create, modify_by, gmt_modified, sensitive_word_ids, default_answer, enabled_faq, depend_on_kb
mapper.update: UPDATE search_config SET `sensitive_word_ids` = TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM REPLACE(CONCAT(',', `sensitive_word_ids`, ','), CONCAT(',', #{wordId}, ','), ',')) WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{wordId}, `sensitive_word_ids`) > 0

UPDATE search_config SET config_json = JSON_SET( config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name', TRIM(BOTH ';' FROM REPLACE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name')), #{baseName}, '')) ) WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{baseName}, '%');

UPDATE search_config SET config_json = JSON_SET( config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name_source', TRIM(BOTH ';' FROM REPLACE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name_source')), #{sourceName}, '')) ) WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name_source')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sourceName}, '%');

UPDATE search_config SET config_json = JSON_SET( config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name_source', TRIM(BOTH ';' FROM REPLACE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name_source')), #{sourceName}, #{targetName})) ) WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_json, '$.knowledge_base_name_source')) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sourceName}, '%');

UPDATE search_config SET config_json = JSON_SET( config_json, REPLACE( JSON_UNQUOTE( JSON_SEARCH(config_json, 'one', #{oldDbLabel}, NULL, '$.database_name[*].label') ), '.key', '.label' ), #{newDbLabel} ) WHERE JSON_SEARCH(config_json, 'one', #{dbKey}, NULL, '$.database_name[*].key') IS NOT NULL

UPDATE search_config SET config_json = CAST( REPLACE(JSON_UNQUOTE(config_json), #{sourceModelName}, #{targetModelName}) AS JSON ) WHERE status = 1 AND JSON_SEARCH(config_json, 'one', #{sourceModelName}) IS NOT NULL;
mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM search_config WHERE status = 1 AND JSON_SEARCH(config_json, 'one', #{modelName}) IS NOT NULL;
